Questions, answered.

Everything people ask before they download.

Is Next Prayer really free?

Yes. The whole app is free: no in-app purchases, no subscription, no ads.

Where do the prayer times come from?

From your mosque. Next Prayer reads the timetable your mosque publishes on mawaqit.net, the network used by more than 8,000 mosques. It doesn't calculate times with an astronomical method, so it shows the times your imam actually follows.

Why are the times different from my other prayer app?

Most prayer apps calculate times from your location with a formula. Next Prayer shows your mosque's own timetable instead. When the two disagree, Next Prayer matches your mosque.

My mosque doesn't show up in the search. What can I do?

It needs to be on mawaqit.net. Search by city as well as by name: mosques are sometimes registered under a name you wouldn't expect. If it isn't there yet, ask your mosque to join. Mawaqit is free for mosques too.

Which prayers does it show?

Fajr, Sunrise, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib and Isha, with the next one counting down in the menu bar. On Fridays, your mosque's Jumua times appear as well.

Can it remind me before each prayer?

If you want it to. Switch on the reminder and your Mac notifies you 10 minutes before each prayer. In the final ten minutes, the countdown also blinks softly in the menu bar.

Does it help during Ramadan?

Yes. Maghrib, the time to break the fast, counts down in your menu bar all afternoon at your mosque's exact time, and Fajr tells you when the fast begins.

Which Macs does it run on?

Any Mac with macOS 14 Sonoma or later. It lives in the menu bar only, with no window and no Dock icon, and opens by itself when you log in.

Does Next Prayer collect my data?

No. No account, no ads, no analytics. The App Store privacy label reads "Data Not Collected". The app only contacts mawaqit.net, to fetch your mosque's timetable.

Is Next Prayer made by Mawaqit?

No. Next Prayer is an independent app by Bilal Khettab, not affiliated with MAWAQIT. It uses the timetables mosques publish on public mawaqit.net pages.

Free. Properly.

The whole app. No locked features, no subscription waiting to pounce.
